_meta.name: Deterministic Red-Flag Triage Reference
_meta.authority: This file is the SOLE source of URGENT classification. The LLM may suggest a red flag, but only a match against this file can set state URGENT. Application logic evaluates these patterns; the model never decides routing.
_meta.match_strategy: case-insensitive substring match over normalized patient text plus extracted symptom terms, with a bounded-proximity fallback for multi-word patterns (see app.safety.engine._proximity_match)

red_flags.label: Chest Pain
red_flags.clinical_concern: Acute coronary syndrome, pulmonary embolism, aortic dissection

red_flags.label: Respiratory Distress
red_flags.clinical_concern: Acute asthma, pneumonia, pulmonary oedema, anaphylaxis

red_flags.label: Suspected Stroke / Acute Neurological Deficit
red_flags.clinical_concern: Cerebrovascular accident, transient ischaemic attack
patterns: vision going black in one eye
sudden severe headache worst of my life

red_flags.label: Loss of Consciousness
red_flags.clinical_concern: Syncope, arrhythmia, seizure, hypoglycaemia, head injury

red_flags.label: Severe or Internal Bleeding
red_flags.clinical_concern: Haemorrhage, upper GI bleed, haemoptysis

red_flags.label: Suspected Anaphylaxis
red_flags.clinical_concern: Life-threatening systemic allergic reaction

red_flags.label: Severe Acute Abdominal Pain
red_flags.clinical_concern: Perforation, appendicitis, ectopic pregnancy, obstruction
patterns: pain so bad I can't stand up straight
worst stomach pain of my life

red_flags.label: High Fever in Infant
red_flags.clinical_concern: Serious bacterial infection in a young child

red_flags.label: Self-Harm or Suicidal Ideation
red_flags.clinical_concern: Psychiatric emergency requiring immediate human support

red_flags.label: Pregnancy-Related Emergency
red_flags.clinical_concern: Antepartum haemorrhage, pre-eclampsia, miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy
patterns: one sided pelvic pain and pregnant
shoulder tip pain and missed period
positive pregnancy test with severe pain

red_flags.label: Possible Sepsis
red_flags.clinical_concern: Systemic infection with organ-dysfunction risk; a leading cause of preventable death that presents as 'just a bad fever'

red_flags.label: Possible Diabetic Ketoacidosis
red_flags.clinical_concern: Life-threatening metabolic complication in a diabetic patient, often mistaken for routine vomiting
patterns: diabetic hoon aur ulti ho rahi
डायबिटीज़ है और उल्टी हो रही

red_flags.label: Suspected Testicular Torsion
red_flags.clinical_concern: Time-critical surgical emergency; organ-salvage window is only a few hours
patterns: sudden groin pain and swelling one side

red_flags.label: Suspected Cauda Equina Syndrome
red_flags.clinical_concern: Spinal nerve compression; delayed treatment risks permanent paralysis and incontinence
patterns: loss of bladder control with back pain
loss of bowel control with back pain
back pain with numbness between legs
peeth dard ke sath peshab par control nahi
पीठ दर्द के साथ पेशाब पर नियंत्रण नहीं

red_flags.label: Severe Acute Asthma Attack
red_flags.clinical_concern: Life-threatening bronchospasm requiring emergency treatment, distinct from routine breathlessness

red_flags.label: Possible Meningitis (extended signs)
red_flags.clinical_concern: Bacterial or viral meningitis; photophobia and severe headache with fever/vomiting beyond simple neck stiffness
patterns: light hurts my eyes and fever
severe headache with fever and vomiting
sar me dard bukhar aur ulti

red_flags.label: Suspected Poisoning or Overdose
red_flags.clinical_concern: Accidental or intentional ingestion of a toxic substance or excess medication

red_flags.label: Active Seizure
red_flags.clinical_concern: Ongoing convulsion or post-ictal unresponsiveness, distinct from a past history of seizures

red_flags.label: Severe or Extensive Burn
red_flags.clinical_concern: Large-area, chemical, or electrical burns needing emergency care, not home dressing
patterns: burnt with hot oil large area

red_flags.label: Ophthalmic Emergency
red_flags.clinical_concern: Chemical eye injury or sudden vision loss requiring same-day ophthalmology, not routine eye-drop management
patterns: curtain came down over my vision

uncertain_combinations.label: Fever with rash
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Fever with rash may indicate dengue or meningococcal disease and requires clinician evaluation.

uncertain_combinations.label: Fever with neck stiffness
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Fever with neck stiffness may indicate meningitis and requires urgent clinician evaluation.

uncertain_combinations.label: Prolonged fever
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Fever persisting beyond one week needs clinician assessment rather than symptomatic treatment.

uncertain_combinations.label: Fever with abdominal pain
uncertain_combinations.clinical_concern: Appendicitis, enteric fever with perforation risk, cholangitis
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Fever combined with abdominal pain needs clinician evaluation to rule out a surgical or septic abdomen.

uncertain_combinations.label: Fever with joint pain
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Fever with joint pain is a classic early dengue/chikungunya presentation and warrants clinician review rather than symptomatic self-treatment, even before bleeding signs appear.

uncertain_combinations.label: Persistent cough with weight loss
uncertain_combinations.rationale: A cough persisting beyond two weeks with unintentional weight loss needs clinician evaluation to rule out tuberculosis or malignancy.

uncertain_combinations.label: Vomiting and diarrhoea beyond the self-limiting window
uncertain_combinations.rationale: Combined vomiting and diarrhoea lasting beyond three days carries a real dehydration risk and should not continue to be managed as routine mild gastroenteritis without clinician review.

uncertain_combinations.label: Headache with fever and vomiting
uncertain_combinations.rationale: The combination of headache, fever and vomiting is a classic soft sign of meningitis or raised intracranial pressure and warrants clinician evaluation even without neck stiffness or photophobia being explicitly reported.

uncertain_combinations.label: Known diabetic with a non-healing wound
uncertain_combinations.clinical_concern: Diabetic foot ulcer, risk of limb-threatening infection
uncertain_combinations.rationale: A non-healing wound in a known diabetic patient is not self-treatable and requires clinician assessment to prevent progression to a limb-threatening infection.
